value: The official 1% check applies only to sampled peak energy at 30.16 us. Independent 1% peak-overlap, peak-force and full-trace energy checks are additional declared checks. The fixed 50.16 us endpoint is still in contact, so residual spring energy is retained; endpoint speed ratio is not separated-body restitution.
Official E=48 GPa and nu=0.20 are used directly in both free spheres. E*=E/[2(1-nu^2)]=25 GPa, and Fn=(4/3)E* sqrt(Reff) delta^(3/2).
This material-input variant verifies the native E/nu-to-effective-modulus branch. No substitute elastic constants, coefficient fitting or solver edits are used.
The second official hertz/material argument zero is damping zero, not restitution zero. FunDEM e=1 gives zero automatic damping.
Actual sliding friction mu=0.35 is retained. Zero transverse motion and spin leave tangential Mindlin force and history inactive, so this case does not validate active friction or tangential damping.
Hertz elastic energy is counted once per contact: U=(2/5) K delta^(5/2). Both particles contribute to kinetic energy.
All configured native frames and every numerical step are retained, including the initial frame.
Official checkpoint and global sampled maxima are recorded separately. Numerical sampling can place the two maxima at a neighboring step.
No gravity, cohesion, global damping, rolling/torsional resistance or initial spin acts; configured sliding friction is inactive in this head-on motion.
No local LAMMPS executable was run; stored reference states are from the pinned official YAML.
Native 0.4.3 CPU/CUDA libraries are tested; byte identity with the installed GUI executable was not established.
